records.title: The Production by Moderate Exercise of a High Incidence of Bends at Altitudes of 26,000 to 28,000 Feet
records.notes: The 9 flights, 18 Table 2 records and 17 Table 3 records belong to one repeated-participant series. Names and demographics were omitted. Blank grade cells indicate no printed outcome.

observations.protocol: 28,000 ft at 3,000 ft/min. Connected to the oxygen regulator at 18,000 ft, automix off. Five deep knee bends and five arm extensions with a 14 lb oxygen cylinder at altitude and every 10 minutes.
observations.outcome_window: During the chamber exposure. Most trials lasted two hours at altitude, the shortest one hour. Individual durations and uniform delayed follow-up are unavailable.
observations.note: The Grade 3 column includes chokes requiring descent where footnoted. Repeated participants and source-level dependence.
